subject: Subprocessor offboarding: escrow options, scope clarifications, and CAIQ/SOC2 evidence
messages:
From: compliance+vendor@omnihealth.com
To: logan_wright@redwood.com
Cc: taylor@edgeops.io
Date: 2026-08-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: subprocessor offboarding plan + escrow evidence

Hi Logan,

Quick note from OmniHealth compliance — we were notified that one of the subprocessors supporting the Redwood/Omni integration (EdgeOps) will be decommissioned in September. Before we can approve the change, we need: 

- A table of impacted subprocessors and the exact data types they process (PII, PHI, telemetry, logs).
- Confirmation of when access will be revoked and KMS key rotation plan.
- Preferred escrow options for customer-recoverable artifacts (encryption, escrow holder, retrieval SLA).
- SOC 2 Type II exhibits that show access controls for the relevant envs + any SIG/CAIQ answers specifically covering offboarding and key management.
- Proposed timeline for customer notification and validation steps.

I've attached our questionnaire to make the mapping easier. Can you respond by EOD so our procurement/security team can coordinate the contract amendment?

Thanks,
Claire Penn
Senior Vendor Risk Manager
OmniHealth

Attachment: omni_questionnaire_v1.xlsx (xlsx - questionnaire template)

From: logan_wright@redwood.com
To: compliance+vendor@omnihealth.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, taylor@edgeops.io
Date: 2026-08-30T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: subprocessor offboarding plan + escrow evidence

Claire — thanks for the heads up and the template. High level reply below and attachments included. I copied Marissa (security lead for subprocessors) and Ben (legal lead) to make sure timeline / contract questions are triaged.

Summary (short):
- Impacted subprocessor: EdgeOps (edgeops.io) — only used for log ingestion/short-term buffering; no long-term customer storage.
- Data types: aggregated telemetry + anonymized request metadata. No customer PHI stored by EdgeOps in our current config; we will include the exact field map in the attached CSV.
- Access revocation: planned staged revocation over 30 days from the notification date (30 calendar days to full cutover), with immediate credential disable for new writes within 72 hours.
- KMS/key rotation: we will rotate the keys used for EdgeOps access on day 10 and rotate a second time on final cutover. Keys are customer-specific ephemeral keys managed in our KMS with separation of duties.
- Escrow option proposed: encrypted archive of schema & replay package held in a neutral escrow (AWS S3 bucket encrypted with customer-controlled KMS; retrieval via DocuSign-authorized request). See attached escrow_proposal_v1.pdf for options and costs.
- Evidence: attaching our subprocessor inventory CSV and a CAIQ mapping template. SOC2 exhibits are available at the link below; we can extract the control IDs you asked for.

Next steps we propose:
1) Sign off on offboarding timeline + escrow approach (we can use DocuSign for the escrow retrieval policy)
2) Marissa to provide the CAIQ/SIG mapping and SOC2 snippets within 48 hours
3) Schedule 30-minute handoff call with EdgeOps + Omni compliance this week to validate field mappings

Attachments: redwood_subproc_inventory_aug2026.csv, escrow_proposal_v1.pdf, CAIQ-mapping-template.xlsx

Logan Wright
Head of Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference

---
On 2026-08-30T09:12:00-07:00, compliance+vendor@omnihealth.com wrote:
> Hi Logan,
> 
> Quick note from OmniHealth compliance — we were notified that one of the subprocessors...

From: taylor@edgeops.io
To: logan_wright@redwood.com, compliance+vendor@omnihealth.com
Date: 2026-08-30T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: subprocessor offboarding plan + escrow evidence

Thanks Logan — quick clarifying note from EdgeOps.

We will fully stop ingest at the requested cutover date, but customers that rely on our replay API will need a retrieval window. We can produce a one-time encrypted archive of the last 90 days of request metadata and instructions for replay. We need confirmation of three things from Redwood/Omni:
- Who will hold the escrow encryption key (customer or Omni/Redwood managed)?
- Will DocuSign approval from Omni be sufficient to trigger retrieval, or do you require a legal PO + notarized affidavit?
- Do you need the CAIQ answers from our side (we have a SIG-lite pack and can provide the specific control responses for offboarding, key rotation, and subprocess termination)?

If you want us to upload the archive to the proposed neutral S3 escrow we can do that, but it will require a short maintenance window (30m) and we will coordinate via the call Logan mentioned.

Taylor Kim
Head of Ops, EdgeOps

Attachment: (none)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: compliance+vendor@omnihealth.com, logan_wright@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, taylor@edgeops.io
Date: 2026-08-30T15:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: subprocessor offboarding plan + escrow evidence

Claire/Taylor — following up with the technical mapping and evidence deliverables. Per Logan's note, I've pulled the CAIQ/SIG mapping and attached the first pass. Highlights: 

- CAIQ mapping: controls mapped for offboarding, key lifecycle, and access revocation are in sheet "Offboard + KMS".
- SOC2 exhibits: control IDs A.8.3, CC6.2 and CC7.3 are relevant; we've staged the export at the Drive link below (RED-2026-SOC2.zip).
- Logs & retention: EdgeOps retained only ephemeral logs for 14 days by default; we will produce the 90-day replay archive as requested and provide a signed statement certifying retention windows.
- Key rotation: Redwood will rotate both the EdgeOps service keys and the replay archive envelope key (customer-facing) — rotation schedule noted on page 2 of escrow_proposal_v1.pdf.

I've uploaded the CAIQ mapping (sig_caik_mapping_redwood.xlsx) and added inline comments where we anticipate follow-up. If Omni wants a signed attestation, Ben — can you confirm the language we should use for the retrieval SLA and escrow release conditions?

Drive link: https://drive.redwood.example.com/Shared/SOC2-Exhibits/RED-2026-SOC2.zip

-Marissa
Director, Security Strategy
Redwood Inference

Attachment: sig_caik_mapping_redwood.xlsx

---
On 2026-08-30T11:05:00-07:00, logan_wright@redwood.com wrote:
> Claire — thanks for the heads up and the template. High level reply below and attachments included...

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: logan_wright@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, compliance+vendor@omnihealth.com
Date: 2026-08-31T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: subprocessor offboarding plan + escrow evidence

Quick sign-off from legal: I approve the proposed 30-day staged offboarding plan and the escrow approach as summarized by Logan and Marissa. For the DocuSign retrieval flow, legal is comfortable with Omni's DocuSign authorization + Redwood countersignature as the release trigger. Marissa — please include the attestation language below in the DocuSign envelope: 

"Redwood attests that (1) EdgeOps had no customer PHI in the affected workflows, (2) archived replay packages are encrypted with customer-keyed envelopes, and (3) retrieval will be executed only with the mutually agreed DocuSign authorization flow and audit trail."

Once Marissa drops the CAIQ mapping and the ZIP slices, we can finalize the amendment and loop Omni for signature.

Ben Carter
Senior Counsel
Redwood Inference
